body: Orchestrator decision from the DM-174 review (this run) — implement here: `criterionKey` in src/core/services/spaceSignals.ts compares id + text.trim() exactly, so a casing-only or inner-whitespace-only criterion edit before acceptance permanently zeroes a committed ticket at sprint/run/epic level. Fold case and collapse inner whitespace in `criterionKey` (substantive rewording stays a change). Also carry a reason when an accepted ticket reads undelivered at sprint level (today only the ticket-level read shows why; four accepted tickets read undelivered with added 0 / removed 0).
